name: U.S. Department of State - Student Visas
verificationAdvice: Verify visa fee and appointment instructions only through official .gov pages and the embassy/consulate appointment portal.
notes: No third party can guarantee visa approval.

name: EducationUSA
verificationAdvice: Use an official EducationUSA advising center to validate admissions and scholarship claims.
notes: Helpful for students applying to U.S. institutions.

name: Immigration, Refugees and Citizenship Canada
verificationAdvice: Check study permit instructions and fee payment only on canada.ca or linked official portals.
notes: Beware agents asking for direct deposits to personal accounts.

name: UK Visas and Immigration
verificationAdvice: Confirm Student visa steps, fees, and CAS requirements through gov.uk and the university admissions office.
notes: CAS numbers should be validated with the sponsoring university.

name: Australian Department of Home Affairs
verificationAdvice: Use official Home Affairs and ImmiAccount channels for visa steps and payments.
notes: Do not send identity documents over messaging apps to unknown agents.

name: IELTS
verificationAdvice: Register through IELTS official test centers and compare payment instructions with the official site.
notes: Fake test slots and result-upgrade offers are common.

name: TOEFL iBT
verificationAdvice: Use ETS official channels for registration, score reporting, and account recovery.
notes: No one can buy a valid score upgrade.

name: University admissions office
verificationAdvice: Navigate from the university homepage, not from message links; verify sender domain and application portal status.
notes: Replace with school-specific official admissions URLs in pilots.
